fixtures.preview: A winless-in-eight United, 16th and just above the drop zone, visit fifth-placed Chelsea with Michael Carrick kept on for this game (11:30pm Sat 31 Oct Sydney).
talking_points: Sky Sports reports Carrick stays in charge at Chelsea after the 3-0 home loss to Bournemouth, with the club giving him at least one more match.
United are 16th on 7 points from 8 games (1 win), per Sky's table updated on 25 October; Chelsea are 5th on 13.
Bruno Fernandes was dropped for the Bournemouth game; Sky says his return depends on his attitude, not an injury, and no injury news was reported.
Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann are named as contenders if Carrick goes, so a result matters; team news isn't confirmed.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford (7am Wed 4 Nov Sydney).
A Sunday 4:30pm UK home game against Villa, who beat Manchester City 2-1 on Saturday.
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time.
Matchday 5 in Lisbon, listed by UEFA at 21:00 CET (7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
Sydney head to AAMI Park for a 5pm Halloween game after their first win of the season (Sat 31 Oct, 5pm Melbourne time).
talking_points: Sydney came from behind to beat Adelaide United 2-1, with Rhys Youlley and Oriola Sunday scoring their first A-League goals for the club.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo praised his side's character after that first win of the season.
Academy graduate Akol Akon is one of 17 A-League Men players picked for the Joeys' FIFA U-17 World Cup squad, so his availability is a question.
Wellington Phoenix topped the ladder after matchweek 2; no Sydney or City team news has been published yet.
